risks: Given includes references in any artifact, while then unconditionally says every feature URN must be built via URNBuilder.feature; a weak coder may be unsure how that applies to literal references in documentation or declarative files, and no builder signature or non-code guidance is supplied.

The prose requires kebab-case, but the supplied regex permits consecutive or trailing hyphens; a weak coder implementing validation could choose different behavior depending on which requirement it treats as authoritative.
